612: // Select returns an available host, if any.
613: func (s CookieHashSelection) Select(pool UpstreamPool, req *http.Request, w http.ResponseWriter) *Upstream {
614: 	// selects a new Host using the fallback policy (typically random)
615: 	// and write a sticky session cookie to the response.
616: 	selectNewHost := func() *Upstream {
617: 		upstream := s.fallback.Select(pool, req, w)
618: 		if upstream == nil {
619: 			return nil
620: 		}
621: 		sha, err := hashCookie(s.Secret, upstream.Dial)
622: 		if err != nil {
623: 			return upstream
624: 		}
625: 		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
626: 			Name:   s.Name,
627: 			Value:  sha,
628: 			Path:   "/",
629: 			Secure: false,
630: 		})
631: 		return upstream
632: 	}
633: 
634: 	cookie, err := req.Cookie(s.Name)
635: 	// If there's no cookie, select a host using the fallback policy
636: 	if err != nil || cookie == nil {
637: 		return selectNewHost()
638: 	}
639: 	// If the cookie is present, loop over the available upstreams until we find a match
640: 	if match := s.lookupStickyUpstream(pool, cookie.Value); match != nil {
641: 		return match
642: 	}
643: 	// If there is no matching host, select a host using the fallback policy
644: 	return selectNewHost()
645: }

part.text: Fixed in `modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/selectionpolicies.go:625` — the sticky cookie now sets `Secure: req.TLS != nil` (true when the request is HTTPS) and `SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode` always, so third-party contexts keep the sticky session. All reverseproxy tests pass, including the secure-request cookie tests.
